existing_study: joint-v1 remains frozen and is reported under its original deadline-first criteria
primary_objective: maximize unique bytes of fully verified objects delivered per second in a fixed measurement window

workload.measurement: fixed offered/measurement interval; report startup and bounded drain separately
workload.correctness: whole-object hash verification and exact bytes; no credit for retransmissions or duplicate delivery
workload.concurrency: one and many active hosts, plus host joins, departures and correlated path changes

training.initialization: imitate a strong adaptive deterministic teacher before joint RL
training.reward: verified useful delivery; incremental byte progress only through potential-based shaping with explicit terminal correction
training.selection: validation only; freeze before fresh paired tests; retain the initial teacher as a candidate

proposed_win_conditions_to_freeze_before.active_host_starvation: none; report per-host goodput and fairness
proposed_win_conditions_to_freeze_before.reference: strongest validated adaptive deterministic control under the same constraints

required_reports: verified receiver goodput and sender-confirmed goodput
finite-object completion time and confirmed completion fraction
interactive deadline misses including blocked desired offers
queue occupancy, latency tails, loss and retransmission overhead
real wall-clock transfers including steady-state actor inference cost
